tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /btsan thabs kyi nyams khrid chen mo'i 'grel pa bzhugs so// shrī gu ra we/ na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ btsan thabs kyi nyams khrid chen mo gsang ba'i nye lam zhes bya ba'i rnam par bshad pa rnal 'byor gyi snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /e waṃ gnyis med ye shes chen po'i mes/ /mtha' yas sgrib pa'i tshang tshing kun sreg cing / /rnam kun mchog ldan sku gsung thugs mtha' yas/ /srid zhi'i mtha' spangs dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gis chos sku bde chen stong gzugs su/ /nyid kyis gzigs nas lam zhugs snod ldan la/ /bde stong gnyis su med pa'i lam ston pa/ /nyams rtogs mthar son bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /de yi gsung ngag rdo rje'i tshig /rtogs dka' gzhan la phan don du/ /sgro skur spangs te gsung ngag las/ /'byung bzhin bdag gis dbye bar bya/ /de la 'dir btsan thabs kyi nyams khrid gsang ba'i nye lam la don gsum ste/ klad kyi don dang / gzhung gi don dang / mjug gi bya ba'o/ /dang po la drug gi/ bzod par gsol ba ni/ bdag gi bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos dpal bzang po rang nyid kyis thugs nyams su bstar ba'i btsan thabs kyi rlung sbyor bdag gzhan gyi gegs rnams sel zhing rtogs pa khyad par can skyed pa'i khrid yig yi ger dgod pa la sprul pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don du mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas/ rig sngags las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bzod pa mdzod cig ces pa ni/ de la zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig go /gnyis pa 'gro bas rtogs par smon pa ni/ bdag ltar sems can mtha' yas pa/ /bshes spring du/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /ri lur bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis/ thog ma med pa nas mar gyur pa rnams la'ang ngo bo bde ba rnam pa gsal ba rang bzhin mi rtog pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can lus sems la 'bar bar gyur cig ces pa ni/

sho lo ka gcig go /gsum pa nyams su myong tshul ni/ rkang pa gsum ste lus ngag yid gsum ye shes dang bcas pa la dbang bzhi bskur nas bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor bstan pas sgrib pa bzhi dag par bya ste/ sku bzhi'i rten 'brel sgrig pa'i phyi brda'i bla mas rnal 'byor pa rang gi sems nyams su myong ba khyad par can gyi lam ston par byed pa'i nang gi bla mar ngo sprad pas nyams myong 'og nas 'byung ba 'di lta bu skyes zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'bad pa'i phan yon ni/ rkang pa gsum ste/ 'og gi rnal 'byor 'di la 'bad na 'di dang skye ba gzhan du 'bras bu yid du 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi phan bde 'byung bar rang gi nyams myong dang lung rnam dag las shes te/ bsdus rgyud du/ bla ma'i nges pa'i dbang las stong par du ba la sogs gzugs brnyan khams ni bsgom par bya ba'o/ /de nas rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams su srog dang thur du rgyu ba'i rlung rnams yang ni brtan par bya/ /gzhan yang zla ba gza' yis 'gog par byed pa bzhin du byang chub sems kyang rnal 'byor pa yis de/ /gang zhig de las khyad par 'dod pa yin te cung zad nyin zhag rnams kyi skye ba 'di ru thob/ /ces dang / snyan brgyud las/ so sor sdud pa'i rtags mthong zhing / /gal te shi bar gyur ba na/ /de ni lam dam pa dang phrad/ /de nas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mtshan brjod du/ don grub bsam pa grub pa de/ /kun tu rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog dbyings mi zad/ /chos dbyings dam pa zad mi shes/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa don gnyis 'dod pa dang phrad par smon pa ni/ rkang pa gnyis te/ skye ba 'di dang / gzhan la phan par 'gyur ba de'i phyir rang gzhan gyi don gnas skabs mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis thob 'dod kyi gang zag rnams rnal 'byor pa'i nyams myong / bla mas bstan pa'i btsan thabs kyi nyams khrid 'di dang phrad par shog ces pa'o/

/drug pa bstan par dam bca' ba ni/ bstan par bya'o zhes drang / gang na/ btsan thabs kyi nyams khrid do/ /rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir ston pa ni/ de la spyir gsang sngags ni/ gang zag dbang po mchog gi lam yin zhing / de la'ang tha ma 'bring mchog gsum gyi/ dbang po mchog tu gyur pa'i lam e waṃ gis mtshon pa'i mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin skyed par byed pa dang / mchog mi 'gyur du/ de ltar rim par gsungs pa'i bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo de nyid e waṃ gi rnam pa'i rdo rje sems dpar rgyal bas rgyud kun bsdus nas gsungs so/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang srog g.yon pa dang / g.yas pa'i rtsar rab tu rgyu ba med par dbu ma dbyer med pa'i yan lag gis bzlos par byed pa'i srog rtsol dang / dpral bar srog 'gro 'ong med par 'dzin pa gnyis ni mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'di myur du rgyud la skyed pa'i lam yin zhing srog rtsol 'dzin pa de las kyang ting nge 'dzin ches myur du bskyed pa btsan thabs kyi lam yin pas so/ /bstan bya de ji lta bu zhe na/ mtshan brjod du/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gshegs shul lam grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis skal med la gsang zhing mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi grong khyer du bgrod pa'i nye lam dang / sras rgyud du/ byis pa rnams ni smin par bya ba'i don du sna tshogs gtso bos snying rje mchog gis sbas pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar mkha' 'gros snod min la sbas shing / dri med 'od du/ byis pa mi mkhas rmongs rnams la/ /rgyud gsang gsal bar ston pa ni/ /ma nyid bu rnams la phan ltar/ /bden don lus can thams cad la/ /rgya 'grel dri ma med 'od kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i yang dag lam/

/rnal 'byor rnams kyis rig byed pas/ /de phyir de ni myur du bri/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis gdams pa zab mo'i snod ldan gyi gang zag la bsngags pa/ sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems pa'i rigs gsum mgon po la sogs pa rnams kyis gsal bar ston zhing / thabs shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i gang zag gi nyams myong bla ma'i zhal las byung ba'i man ngag go /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis las/ mdor bstan pa ni/ de la zhes so/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la drug rlung bcu gcig la rgyan sbyar la lnga/ rdo rje bzlas pa la brten pa'i rgyan can/ rdor bzlas spangs ba'i rgyan can/ bgegs bsal ba'i tshul/ rtsa'i dral rtags brtan pas grib ma bsal tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ btsan thabs la gnyis yod pa de la rgyan can gyi btsan thabs zhes bya ba 'og gi rlung kun la sham bur btags te/ de la rdo rje bzlas pa dang / 'jam rlung dgang stong / khro bo hūm̐ 'dren zhi ba oṃ 'dren/ bum pa can 'chi med dang / bde bsgrub pa'i kha sbyor gnyis/ thur sel gyi rlung rnam pa gsum/ hūm̐ phaṭa de bcu gcig la sbyar bar bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis kyi mdor bstan pa ni/ rdo rje bzlas pa dag la'ang gnyis te/ rdor bzlas sngon du song nas btsan thabs la 'jug pa dang / rdor bzlas rgyun chags su byed pa la btsan thabs sbyar ba'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bdun/ rdor bzlas sngon song gi dang / rdor bzlas rgyun chags kyi btsan thabs dang / gnas skabs su rgyan med sgom tshul/ nus pa mchog gi rgyan can/ thur sel la sbyar ba'i btsan thabs/ chang kun ji ltar bsgom tshul/ rgyan can gyi byung tshul dang yon tan no/ /dang po la dgu'i rdor bzlas la brten pa'i btsan thabs kyi dbye ba ni/ sngon song la'ang grang sel tsha sel phus 'ded la rten pa gsum gyi/ grangs sel la dbye na gsum ste/ zla ba dang nyi ma rtsa gnyis dang / de gnyis ka'i dbus su rdo rje'i bzlas pa sgrub pa la btsan thabs sbyar ba'i rengs lugs gsum du 'dod cing /

tsha sel la'ang rnam pa gsum ste/ zla nyi dang dbus nas rlung nang du drangs te kha ka ling kar bton pa'i bzlas pa la btsan thabs sbyar ba'i rengs lugs gsum dang / ka ling ka nas rlung nang du drangs te/ zla nyi'i rtsa'i sgo sna bug g.yas g.yon dang / de gnyis kyis dbus nas srog phyir bton pa'i rdo rje bzlas pa gsum la btsan thabs sbyar ba'i rengs lugs gsum dang / rlung ma bzung ba rengs pa ste bcu'o/ /gnyis pa rtsa ba'i rlung sbyor dgu la sbyar ba'i btsan thabs ni/ rdor bzlas 'jam rlung hūm̐ 'dren oṃ 'dren bum pa can kha sbyor gnyis/ gzhung bzhin 'gugs pa myur sdud hūm̐ phaṭa te/ rtsa ba'i rlung sbyor dgu po re re la rlung nang du bzung ba la btsan thabs sbyar ba'i srog rengs pa dgu rlung phyir song ba la btsan thabs sbyar ba'i rengs pa dgu ste bco brgyad dang de rnams la man ngag byin te rlung sbyor bco brgyad po de dag sngon song gi btsan thabs dang rgyun chags la rgyan sbyar ba gnyis kyis phye na sngar gyi nyis 'gyur rengs lugs so drug tu 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa rdor bzlas sngon song gi hūm̐ 'dren/ oṃ 'dren la sbyar ba ni/ rdor bzlas tsha sel grang sel phus 'ded dgu po re re sngon du song nas/ hūm̐ 'dren la'ang rgyan sbyar ba'i rengs pa dgu dang / de bzhin du oṃ 'dren la'ang sbyar ba'i rengs pa dgu la sngon song rgyun chags la sbyar ba'i rengs pa gnyis kyis dbye bas phye ba'i man ngag dang ldan na nyis 'gyur du 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa rdor bzlas sngon song gi rlung sbyor gzhan rnams la sbyar ba ni/ rdo rje bzlas pa dgu po gang rung re sngon du song ba la bum pa can dang sogs pas 'jam rlung kha sbyor thur sel hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs pa sham bur btags pa la rgyan sbyar ba dang / de la'ang sngon song dang rgyun chags kyis phye ba'i rengs pa la sogs rgyan can grangs med dag tu 'gyur na yang /

khrid yig 'dir ni kho bos rgyan can mdor bstan pa tsam yin gyi/ zhib tu rgya cher rnal 'byor pa rang gi nyams myong bla ma'i zhal dag la dris te shes par bya ba yin te/ kun mkhyen pa yang mthar thug rigs pas dbye bar dpyad pa la thug pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa tsha ba phus 'ded la sbyar ba bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ tsha ba phus 'ded la ni/ rengs lugs rnam pa dgu ste/ phu'i rdo rje bzlas pa sngon du 'gro bas phye na sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge gsum gyi rnam par rlung phyir bton pa la/ nyi zla mun can rengs pa gsum dang / rlung nang bzung ba la'ang sna rtsa g.yas g.yon dang / gnyis ka rengs pa gsum dang / kha nyid nas rlung phyir bzung ba ste btang ba la rengs pa dang / rlung kha nas nang du bzung ba la rengs pa dang / rlung ma bzung ba la rengs pa gsum ste dgu ni tsha ba phus 'ded/ ces su brjod do/ /drug pa rgyan can grangs med du 'gyur tshul ni/ sngar bstan pa'i tsha ba phus 'ded kyi rlung la brten pa'i rgyan can de dag ni mdo tsam du bstan pa yin gyi/ de dag gi skabs su nyi zla'i rtsa dgag pa drag zhan dang / rlung gi 'gro 'ong drag zhan dang / rlung 'byung 'jug gi grangs mang nyung dang / rgyan sbyar ba'i bye brag gis btsan thabs grangs med dag tu 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa de dag gi skabs su sems 'jog tshul ni/ btsan thabs de dag nyams su len pa na/ mthar thug gi don bsgoms pa gnad che ste/ de gang na rang gi sems kyi rang bzhin skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba bya byed kyi 'dzin pas stong pa'i phyag rgya chen po yin la de nyid kyi ngang la ma bcos par gnyug ma'i ye shes kyi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du mi g.yo ba gsum dang ldan pas mnyam par bzhag pa na rang gi sems gsal la rang gi ngo bo stong pa rtog pa med pa'i chos kyi sku dang / gzung yul med kyang rna bar sgra yid du mi 'ong ba sna tshogs thos pa'i dril can gyi sgra ni longs sku dang /

du ba smig rgyu nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i bar gzugs sna tshogs rang bzhin stong bzhin du mig shes la snang ba sprul pa'i sku dang / phyi rol gyi reg bya dang bral yang lus sems la brjod du med pa'i bde ba chen po 'char ba ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ sku bzhi'i zhal mngon sum du mthong zhes brjod do/ /de ni 'o ma bsrubs pa las mar 'byung ba dang 'dra bar lam gyi snying po yin pas 'di nyid rlung sbyor kun gyi skabs su sbyar te bsgom par bya'o/ /brgyad pa rgyan can shes pa'i phan yon ni/ gang zag gang gis btsan thabs rgyan can shes pa de dper na dmag mi g.yul du 'jug pa'i tshe go mtshon dang ldan pa dang / rta la zhon pa'i tshe sga srab phun tshogs dang / la sgor tshong la 'gro ba la zong sna tshogs yod pa dang 'dra bar/ gegs las rgyal ba dang / rlung bcings te/ ting nge 'dzin nyams 'og tu chud pa dang / bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams sna tshogs rgyud la 'char ro/ /dgu pa rgyan can mi shes pa'i skyon ni/ sho lo ka gcig ste snga ma las bzlog ste bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdor bzlas rgyun chags kyi btsan thabs ni/ sho lo ka gsum dang rkang pa gcig ste/ rdo rje bzlas pa rgyun chags la'ang dbye na grang sel tsha sel gnyis las grang sel la'ang gnyis te/ sngar bstan pa'i rdo rje bzlas pa bcu sogs rab tu bsgrubs pa'i rjes su rgyan 'jug pa dang / sngon la rlung rengs par byas pa'i rjes su rdor bzlas bcu byed pa gnyis las/ zla nyi'i dbus su rengs pa gsum gsum gyis phye bas drug dang / tsha sel la'ang gnyis te zla nyi dbus gsum nas srog nang du bcug ste kha ka ling ka nas bton pa'i bzlas pa gsum dang / ka ling ka nas srog nang du drangs te/ zla nyi'i dbus gsum nas bton pa'i bzlas pa'o/ /de gnyis la bzlas pa gnyis sngon du btang nas rengs pa gsum gsum ste drug dang / sngon la rengs nas de'i rjes su bzlas pa drug ste/

de ltar na grang sel la drug tsha sel gnyis la drug ste bco brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /de dag la rtsa gnyis dang rlung gi 'gro 'ong drag zhan la sogs pa'i bye brag gis btsan thabs grangs med du 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa gnas skabs su rgyan med sgom tshul ni/ gong gi rlung sbyor sgom pa'i skabs su rlung rgyan med dag kyang sgom zhing rdo rje bzlas pa'ang snga ma de bzhin du rgyan med pa'ang bar bar du sgom pa yin no/ /des ngal gsos shing zhi gnas 'phel bar 'gyur/ bzhi pa nus pa'i mchog gi rgyan can ni/ tsha sel grang sel gang yin yang rung rdo rje bzlas pa sngon du byas nas bum pa can dang kha sbyor gnyis dang / hūm̐ phaṭa dang rnam pa bzhi las btsan thabs dag ni sbyar ba na snang stong gsal stong bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyed pa'i nus pa rlung sbyor gzhan las mchog tu gyur pa ste/ rlung sbyor bzhi po de sngon dang btsan thabs sbyar ba dang / sngon la rengs nas rlung bzhi po sbyor ba'i man ngag byin na rlung sbyor brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa thur sel la sbyar ba'i btsan thabs ni/ thur sel gyi rlung la ni rnam pa gsum ste/ mda' ltar 'phen pa/ gzhu ltar dgug pa/ myur sdud do/ /de gsum la sbyar ba'i rengs pa gsum yod de/ de la sngon song rgyan chags kyi man ngag byin pas drug tu 'gyur ro/ /drug pa rlung kun ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/ rlung kun gyi sham bur rgyan btags pa na rnal 'byor pa de la bde la stong gi nyams myong khyad par du 'phags pa 'byung la/ de la'ang lus la tsha grang shas gang che dang / sems la bying rgod shas gang che dang / kha zas bsil drod gang bsten pa shas che ba dang / nam zla dus tshes grangs gang yin pa la sogs pa rang nyid kyis legs par zhib tu dpyad nas tsha ba shas che ba'i nam zla dus tshod gang zag rnams la grang ba'i rlung gtso bor dang / de bzhin du grang ba shas che ba rnams la tsha ba'i rlung sbyor gtso bor bsten na yon tan mchog tu 'phel bar 'gyur bas/

de ltar bya zhing / de las bzlog nas nyams su blangs na lus sems la duḥkha skyed pas spang bar bya'o/ /bdun pa rgyan can gyi yon tan ni/ de lta bu'i rgyan can gyi rlung sbyor 'di ni btsan thabs kyi nyams khrid chen mo las bshad pa'i man ngag yin la/ de dag gang las na nyams myong bla ma'i zhal las byung zhing / yon tan ci yod na btsan thabs rgyan can zhes bya ba 'di ni rnam rtog rigs bzhi 'joms pa'i tho ba yin la/ las kyi rlung nyi khri chig stong gsod pa'i gshed ma dang / duḥkha brgyad gsum bsreg pa'i bud shing dang / sgrib gnyis kyi nad sel ba'i sman pa dang / thabs shes rab dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis lus brtas par byed pa'i 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang zhing sbas pa'i thar pa'i nye lam dang / sku bzhi'i zhal ston pa'i bla ma'ang yin no/ /gnyis pa rdor bzlas spangs pa'i rgyan can la gnyis kyi dngos po mdor bstan ni/ rkang pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la dgu las/ 'jam rlung la sbyar ba ni/ 'jam rlung dgang stong la ni btsan thabs sham bur gdags shing / de la nyi zla rengs pa gnyis su 'gyur la/ de la'ang sngon song rgyun chags byin pas rengs lugs bzhir 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa hūm̐ 'dren la sbyar ba ni/ hūm̐ 'dren la ni rengs lugs gsum ste zla nyi dbus su rengs pa'i dbye bas phye bas so/ /de la sngon song rgyun chags kyi man ngag byin pas drug tu 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa oṃ 'dren la sbyar ba ni/ oṃ 'dren la'ang rnam pa gsum ste/ nyi zla mun can rengs pa gsum gyis phye bas so/ /de la sngon song rgyun chags kyi man ngag byin na drug tu 'gyur/ bzhi pa grangs med du 'gyur tshul ni/ gong gi rlung sbyor de rnams la sgal tshigs ri'i rgyal po ri rab mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon du skyod pa dang / lto ba rgya mtsho g.yas g.yon steng 'og tu dkrug pa dang /

mdun nang dang rgyab phyi dang lus kyi steng zur gnyis kyang steng du 'then dang / nu ma o ṭe khu tshur gyis rdung ba dang / bya brnyangs la sogs pa lus kyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs dag gis ni srog rengs lugs sna tshogs dag tu 'gyur bas btsan thabs grangs med ces su brjod do/ /lnga pa rgyan can gyi yon tan ni gong du bstan pa de lta bu'i sgrib gnyis kyi bud shing sreg par byed pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi me/ dbang bzhi pa'i don sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni 'khor ba las thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam phyag rgya chen po dngos su ston byed kyi bla ma'ang yin la/ 'di bgrod par dka' ba'i thar pa'i grong khyer du skye ba 'di la 'jug pa'i bzhon pa'ang yin zhing 'di ni phyed par dka' ba'i thar pa'i sgo dbu ma ye shes kyi rtsa 'byed par byed pa'i lde mig yin/ 'di ni mthong bar dka' ba'i thar pa'i grong khyer ston par byed pa'i sgron ma yin no/ /drug pa gnyis ka'i rlung sbyor bzhi la sbyor ba ni/ rlung bum pa can dang / kha sbyor gnyis hūm̐ phaṭa dang ni rnam pa bzhi la sngon song rgyun chags man ngag ldan pas btsan thabs brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /mi bdag kye zhes bos nas bstan pa yin no/ /der ma zad ri bo skyod pa rgya mtsho dkrug pa sogs lus kyi rnam 'gyur du ma dang / nyi zla'i rtsa bsdam pa drag zhan dang / kha zas bsil drod la sogs pa'i bye brag gis lus sems la ngo bo bde ba rnam pa gsal ba/ rang bzhin mi rtog pa'i nyams sna tshogs 'char bas de skyed byed kyi sgyu lus kyi rnam 'gyur sogs kyi dbye bas phye na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan du 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa 'og rlung gsum la sbyar tshul ni/ thur rgyu'i rlung gsum la rgyan btags pas lus la bde ba khyad par can 'phel bar byed de/ de'i phyir bde nyams chung na rlung sbyor 'di rnams la nan tan bya ba yin no/

/brgyad pa drag po'i rgyan du 'gyur tshul ni/ rlung kun gyi sham bur btsan thabs btags pa na drag po'i rgyan du 'gyur ba yin pas/ rtog pa shas che na tshul 'di bsgom pa gnad du che'o/ /dgu pa rjes su nyams bskyang tshul ni/ gong gi rlung sbyor rnams bsgom pa'i rjes su skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i rang gi sems gdod ma nas gsal zhing rig pa rgyu rkyen gyis ma bslad pa'i rig stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal ba ste/ de'i pho sgo la lta ba dang / gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa'i rtogs pa'i shes rab phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la lta ba dang / mig sogs dbang po yul la 'jug pa'i bya ba med par mi rtog ting nge 'dzin gyi bdag nyid du g.yo ba med pa ni dmigs med snying rje ste/ de'i mdangs la g.yo med du blta ba dang / gsal stong rtog pa med pa chos kyi sku'i rang zhal rang nyid kyis blta zhing gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i bsre bslad dang bral bar gyis zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa gegs bsal ba la bzhi'i/ dang po lugs 'byung lugs bzlog tu bsgoms pas rlung gegs bsal ba ni/ btsan thabs rgyan can de lta bu sgom pa na rtsa ba'i rlung bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i rlung sbyor rnams lugs las byung ba snga phyi'i rim pa khrid rim ji lta ba bzhin sgom pa dang / lugs las bzlog pa 'jug nas rim pa bzhin rdo rje bzlas pa'i bar dag tu bsgom pa dang / re mos su spel nas rdo rje bzlas pa nas rtsa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa lta bu'i bar du rlung sbyor re re bzhag nas bsgom pa dang / go rim nges med du bsgoms pa yis tsha ba yi rlung gegs rnams grang rlung gi sbyor bas sel la/ grang ba'i rlung gegs rnams tsha ba'i rlung sbyor gyis sel zhing / rlung sbyor snga ma bsgoms thal ba'i gegs rnams phyi ma bsgoms pas sel bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rlung gi gegs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rnal 'byor pas thob par 'gyur ro/

/gnyis pa gang zag gi bye brag gi rim pa dang cig car sgom tshul ni/ gang zag rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad bzhi lus la yod pa can dang / steng 'og la sogs pa'i gdon rigs kyi gnod pa yod pa can dang / rgas pa dang snying rus chung ba'i gang zag rnams kyi sngar gyi rlung sbyor rnams rim gyis nyams sad cing sgom pa man ngag yin te/ thog babs su bsgoms na snga ma gnyis la ni nad dang gdon gyis rkyen byas nas gegs su song ba srid la/ phyi ma gnyis ni gegs byung na lus sems gcun nas bsgom mi nus shing / de dag la brten nas gegs ma sel na chos dang gang zag la yid ches mi skye ba'i skyon yod pas so/ /lus dar la bab cing nad gdon gyi skyon med pa'i gang zag la thog babs su rlung sbyor rnams drag tu bsgom pa gnad du che ste/ yon tan myur du skye zhing gegs byung na bsal sla ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa khyad par du thig le'i gegs bsal tshul ni/ gal te rlung sbyor bsgoms pa mang ba yis rlung gis thig le byer bar gyur pa na gang zag de'i lus mdog nag cing skam mgo bo 'khor ba dang / bkrag dang lus stobs chung ba dang / mig gi dbang po mi gsal zhing khong du shor ba dang phal cher lus 'khyags 'brum can du 'gyur la snying mi dga' ba dang / gnas gang du bsdad kyang nyams mi dga' la/ grogs su dang 'grogs kyang 'tshig pa za ba dang / lus grang ba shas che zhing ba spu ldog pa la sogs thig le byer ba'i rtags de rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de byung ma thag tu oṃ 'dren gyi sbyor ba nyi ma gcig bsgoms pa nyid kyis sel bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang zas bcud can bsten pa dang tsha ba gsum gyi 'gam phye dang gcan gzan gyi lpags pa la sogs pa dro ba'i gos gyon pa dang / thig le bsgom pa la sogs pas kyang sel bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag nyams su blangs pas bkrag mdangs dang lus kyi stobs 'phel ba la sogs pa thig le 'phel ba'i rtags snga ma las bzlog pa 'byung ngo /

/bzhi pa de las gzhan pa'i gegs bsal ba ni/ rlung dang thig le byer ba'i gegs de dag las gzhan pa'i thig le 'dzag pa dang / 'byung ba lus 'khrugs la sogs pa'i gegs byung na 'di rtsom pa po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gegs sel lam gyi go char ltos la/ bla ma'i man ngag rang gi nyams pha rol po'i bsam pa dang sbyar te nyams sad cing bsal bar bya'o/ /lnga pa rtsa'i dral rtags brtan pa ni/ gong du bstan pa'i btsan thabs rgyan can zhes bya ba bsgoms pas/ lo bcu drug man chad du rtsa rnams rim pa bzhin bskams shing rkyen gyis rtsa chad pa rnams rlung gis dral zhing mthud par gyur pa na/ lus kyi stobs rgyas shing ldang ba yang la lus gzi mdangs dang ldan rtsa rnams 'gul zhing 'phrig pa dang / ngag gi glu dbyangs len pa dang / lus kyi phyi nas sems can 'dzag pa dang / chu 'bab pa lta bu'i nyams dang cung zad mgo bo na la bro 'khrab snying 'dod pa dang / mchong rgyug dang 'gro ba mgyogs pa lta bu la sogs 'byung / ngag gi glu dbyangs len pa la sogs pa dang / tshigs bcad rtsom pa la sogs pa 'byung / sems ni dga' zhing cung zad rgod pa lta bu dang / grub mtha'i rnam dbye sna tshogs pa 'char zhing / mdor na gang snang ba thams cad bde snang 'ba' zhig tu 'char/ de'i tshe rmi lam du bug pa dog mor 'dzul ba dang / srang kha dog mor phyin pa dang / khang pa'i sgo ni gdangs pa mang po dang / khang pa mang po 'jig pa dang / nam mkhar 'phur bar rmi ba la sogs pa rtsa'i dral rtags sna tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba na gegs su bzung nas bar chad du song dogs yod pas ngo shes pa gal che'o/ /drug pa grib ma bsal tshul la lnga'i/ dang po grib gsum gyis phog pa'i rtags ni/ gal te lam sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa la grib kyis phog pa na bsgoms pa'i nyams dang rtags snang thams cad nub par gyur pas grib bsal ba gces so/ /de la grib kyis phog lugs ni/ steng lha'i gdon gyi grib kyis phog ste/

gza' bdud rgyal po la sogs kyis gnod par gyur pa na rgyu mtshan med par 'tshig pa za zhing sgyid lugs pas lus ngag gi bya ba thams cad phyi bshol la lus pa dang / rmi lam du lha khang stong pa dang btsun pa dang ba mi skye ba'i gzugs dang / bro rtse ba dang / bud med nag mo khros pas zas ster ba dang / bya pho/ bu chung / byi la/ mi dkar/ khyi dkar/ mdze pho la sogs pa rmi zhing 'og klu dang sa bdag gi gdon gyi grib phog pa na lus khol bur na zhing phrig pa dang / smin ma dang ba spu byi/ lus la phol dang mdze shu la sogs 'byung / yan lag zha 'khums su 'gyur zhing rmi lam du sdig sbrul bsre mong ba lang dang g.yag dang / nya sbal la sogs pa sna tshogs kyis lus la btab par rmi ba 'byung la/ mi gtsang ba'i grib kyis phog pa na khams mi bde zhing / dang ga 'gag pa dang / lus grang shum la sogs pa 'byung / rmi lam du chu rnyog ma can dang / ngan skyugs dang 'dam rdza ba la sogs pa dang / gos nag gyon pa dang / stan nag 'ding ba dang / lus la shig gis btab pa la sogs pa 'byung ste/ mi bzang ba de ni dam nyams la sogs pa'i grogs ngan pa rnams dang / zas dang / gnas grib can dang / ro'i rtsar phyin pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis 'byung ngo / /rang dam tshig nyams pa'am grib kyis khongs su bsdu'o/ /de la ni dam tshig gi grib ces bya ste/ grib ma chen po yin la/ gdon/ grogs/ zas/ gnas kyi grib ma ni 'bring yin zhing / ro grib ni chung ngur shes par bya'o/ /rmi nyams la'ang rmi rtags de dag gis gos gnas khang la sogs pa gos gsar rmi na/ grib ma che 'bring chung ngu gsum ste/ de ltar grib kyi rnam dbye shes par byas la brtag go /gnyis pa de dag bsal ba'i tshul ni/ steng gdon gyi grib la ni gshin rje gshed dmar nag dang / 'og gdon la ni phyag rdor mi g.yo ba sogs kyi bsgom bzlas dang / mi gtsang ba la rnam 'joms dang /

yig brgya'i bzlas pa dang / khrus chog tshogs 'khor tsha tsha srog bshags pa dbang blang ba sogs kyis grib ma de dag bsal lo/ /gsum pa grib kyis phog pa'i skyon ni/ grib ma chen pos rnal 'byor pa'i srog 'phrog par byed/ 'bring gis lus sems la sdug bsngal na tsha byed/ ting nge 'dzin 'phrog chung ngus kyang dge sbyor 'phrog ste nyams rtogs nub par byed do/ /des na grib ma bsal ba gces pa'i phyir/ grib phog ma phog mi shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa de/ gdol pa shan pa dag las khyad ci yang med pas grib shes pa dang bsal ba gal che'o/ /bzhi pa gang la phog pa'i tshul ni/ rnal 'byor pa gang nam mkha' dang 'dra bar blang dor dgag sgrub bral na ngo mtshar che zhing grib mi 'byung ste chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas so/ /dar dkar 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa la grib ma 'byung ste/ rtsa rlung dwangs shing re dogs dang ma bral bas so/ /re ba 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa la grib mi 'ong ste/ mi gtsang ba'i rang bzhin yin pas so/ /dper na sol ba la sogs pas re ba sngar gyi de bas nag tu ga la 'gro ste mi 'gro ba bzhin no/ /lnga pa grib ma phog pa'i yon tan ni/ srog rtsol gyi rtsa rlung dwangs shing grib med na lus sems la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong sna tshogs 'char la/ rtsom pa po bdag gis smras pa bzhin 'dug mi 'dug rnal 'byor pas nyams myong bla ma'i zhal las dris shes par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa mjug gi don la gsum gyi/ rang don du bsngo ba ni/ lo paṇa du ma byon pa'i gnas khro phu'i gtsug lag khang dang nye ba'i shab kyi sa cha'i snyan dkar seng ge rdzong du seng ge bzhin bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong gi g.yu ral ngom bzhin du chos dpal bzang pos 'du 'dzis dben pa'i gnas su sgo gsum dben par bsdad de bsgoms pas/ dben pa bsten pa'i 'bras bu gnas skabs zhi lhag zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin dang /

mthar thug sgrib pas dben pa'i ye shes chen po dang bcas par gyur cig pa'o/ /gnyis pa snod ldan la bsngo ba ni rnal 'byor pa'i nyams myong bla ma'i zhal las byung zhing nyams myong dang man ngag can gyis nyams su blangs pa'i btsan thabs kyi nyams khrid 'dis nyams myong dang gdams pa zab mo'i skal bar ldan pa la nyams myong gi 'bras bu bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams lus sems la rgyas par gyur cig gsum pa 'gro ba spyir bsngo ba ni/ nyams khrid yi ger bkod pa'i dge ba 'di yis mar gyur 'gro ba rnams srid zhi'i lam gnyis kyi mthar zhen pa myur du spangs nas mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i dbu ma bde stong dbyer med kyi lam la rab tu zhugs te rgyal ba'i sku bzhi mngon sum du byed par shog ces pa'am/ yang na 'gro 'ong gi rlung rnams ro rkyang gi lam du 'jug pa spangs nas dbu ma ye shes kyi rtsar zhugs te rlung g.yo med khams 'dzag med du gyur pas/ gsang ba lte ba snying ga mgrin pa dang dpral ba/ spyi gtsug gi 'khor lo rnams su thig le brtan par gyur te sku bzhi mngon du byed par shog ces pa'o/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras rnams kyis legs bstan zhing / /nyams ldan nyams su myong bas rtogs pa yi/ /gdams pa gdams pa'i mchog 'di gzhan dag las/ /gangs can gangs ri'i khrod na rnyed par dka'/ /de ltar bla ma la gus khengs bral zhing / /dbang dang dam tshig ldan pa'i gang zag la/ /phan par bya dang gdams pa mi nyams phyir/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i rnam bshad don ldan 'di/ /rnam dpyod don ldan blo can don gnyer ba/ /dpal ldan rgyal ba'i sde yis bskul ba'i ngor/ /mdo rgyud man ngag du ma'i mthar son pa/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes byas legs par sbyar/ /'di la nongs pa mchis na bla ma dang / /mkha' 'gros bzod mdzod rtag tu byin gyis rlobs/ /dge bas bdag gzhan srid zhi'i rgud pa las/ /myur du grol te bde chen mngon gyur shog

/gdams pa 'di 'dra gzhan na dkon/ /de phyir kun la gsang bar bya/ /snod dang ldan la'ang sbyin pa na/ /gser yon bcas na cung zad bstan/ /bdag gi ser sna ma lags te/ /chos la mchog tu yid ches dang / /bla mas bka' rgyas btab pa dang / /bka' srung shin tu gnyan phyir ro/ /btsan thabs kyi nyams khrid chen mo gsang ba'i nye lam zhes bya ba'i rnam bshad rnal 'byor gyi snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpa' bo'i lo nag pa'i zla ba'i dkar phyogs tshes gcig la/ bla ma'i man ngag dang / gsung gi yi ge gzhan la brten nas/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mtshal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang chen por legs par sbyar ba'o/ /ka legs nam/ 'dir yi ges dngos su zin pa'i rlung sbyor brgya dang bzhi bcu bdog oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tunte ṣān ta tha ga to hya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ madga laṃ bha wantu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 bla ma dam pa/ btsan thabs kyi nyams khrid chen mo'i 'grel pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
